name: Volumetric Display Scanning Route Optimization
aliases: Christofides Algorithm for Volumetric Display Scanning
definition: A method for generating volumetric graphics with multicolored voxels by slicing 3D point cloud data into layers along the optical axis (z), calculating an optimal scanning order for vertices within each layer to minimize travel distance, and synchronously controlling galvanometer scanners, a varifocal lens, and an LC color filter.
summary: Volumetric Display Scanning Route Optimization uses the Christofides algorithm to solve the Traveling Salesman Problem for each depth layer, balancing optimality with deterministic execution time to minimize scan distance and latency.
